# Bundled OCR dependencies

- Tesseract.js 5.1.1 — https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js — Apache-2.0.
  License: LICENSE-tesseract.md.
- Tesseract.js-core 5.1.1 (Tesseract/Leptonica WebAssembly distribution) —
  https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core — Apache-2.0 distribution license:
  LICENSE-core.txt. Embedded third-party notices remain in the original bundles.
- English and Vietnamese traineddata, distributed by
  https://tessdata.projectnaptha.com/4.0.0/ from the Tesseract language data project:
  https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata — Apache-2.0.

The distributed library files and model files are unmodified. `assets.json`
records original download locations and SHA-256 hashes.
